title: HR Operations Administrator
description:
HR Operations Administrator Growing Retail Business

Zachary Daniels are recruiting for an HR Operations Administrator to join a growing retail business in a varied, hands-on role supporting both the People function and wider business operations.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone who loves organisation, has great attention to detail and enjoys being the person who keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

You'll get involved across the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to payroll, employee records, absence, compliance and workforce reporting, alongside providing wider operational support to the business.

What you'll be doing
- Maintaining accurate employee records and HR system information
- Preparing contracts, offer letters, amendments and leaver documentation
- Supporting recruitment, including interview coordination and candidate communication
- Managing pre-employment checks and new starter onboarding
- Making sure new starters have everything they need from day one, including systems, training and equipment
- Supporting the monthly payroll process, ensuring employee changes, payments and deductions are accurate
- Processing expenses and helping resolve payroll queries
- Maintaining accurate absence, attendance and workforce information
- Monitoring absence trigger points and supporting managers with the relevant processes
- Tracking mandatory training, CPD and compliance requirements
- Producing regular People and workforce reports
- Supporting managers with day-to-day HR and operational queries
- Coordinating supplies, facilities queries and other general operational administration
- Supporting with reports, presentations and data
- Looking for ways to improve processes and make things run more efficiently

About you

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and comfortable juggling lots of different priorities.

You'll ideally have experience within HR administration, People operations, payroll, retail operations or a broader business support role.

You'll be confident working with systems and data, have strong attention to detail and be comfortable handling confidential information. Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills are important, along with the confidence to communicate with managers and colleagues across the business.

Most importantly, you'll be someone who takes ownership, uses their initiative and enjoys being in a role where you can get involved in lots of different areas.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking for a broad HR Operations role where you'll gain exposure across People, payroll, compliance and the wider running of a growing business.

Please apply with your most up-to-date CV!

title: Motor claims handler - Part time
description:

Part-time hours available plus Full time

Role Overview

As a Recoveries Handler, you will be responsible for recovering credit hire invoices under commercial hire agreements and the GTA (General Terms of Agreement). You will work closely with insurers, negotiate settlements, manage aged debt, and escalate cases through the litigation process when necessary. Given the high-value nature of their clients' vehicles, this role requires a self-starter with a resilient and determined mindset, as well as strong knowledge of credit hire recovery and the GTA.

Basic monthly salary plus monthly bonus up to £750 per month

Key Responsibilities
- Recover high-value credit hire invoices from insurers and at-fault parties in line with commercial hire agreements and the GTA.
- Prepare and submit invoices to insurers, ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.
- Negotiate settlements on high-performance vehicle claims to achieve optimal recovery outcomes.
- Proactively chase aged debt, ensuring timely payments and reducing outstanding balances.
- Escalate cases to litigation where necessary, working with solicitors and legal teams to pursue recovery.
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth processing and resolution of claims.
- Monitor and report on debt recovery progress, identifying trends and opportunities for process improvements.

Required Skills & Experience
- Minimum of 2 years' experience in credit hire recovery within a legal or insurance setting.
- Strong knowledge of the GTA and credit hire litigation processes.
- Proven ability to negotiate settlements on high-value claims and recover outstanding debts efficiently.
- Exceptional resilience, determination, and self-motivation in high-pressure environments.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to build strong relationships with insurers and legal teams.
- Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.).

Part time hours to suit individual or full time

My client will also consider candidates wishing to return to the industry

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Life insurance
- 25 days holiday plus bonus
- Private medical insurance
- Sick pay
